description:
NovaTech Studios is a creative technology and product studio crafting interactive web applications, real-time collaboration platforms, and modern digital experiences. We partner with fast-growing startups and international scale-ups to turn ambitious product visions into performant, intuitive web solutions.

We are looking for a versatile Fullstack Web Developer to join our Product Engineering team.

In this role, you will own features end-to-end—from responsive, pixel-perfect frontend components to reliable backend API endpoints and data models. You will work closely with UX/UI designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to deliver seamless, accessible user experiences.
